series.name: Diamond 5G hybrid (PV6500/8500/13000 class)
series.notes: Primary Ziewnic-badged manual (4.5/6.5kW scan). Voltronic-class bare 01–59 + W-codes. Program-25 = fault history recorder (not a code). OCR: 100 vs 120°C uncertain.

causes.ur: Dust ya bearing jam ho jana

causes.en: Fan bearing seized or clogged with dust
causes.ur: Fan ka bearing jam ya dust se bhara hua

causes.en: Fan connector loose / fan motor failed
causes.ur: Fan connector dhila ya fan motor fail

solutions.en: Power off and unplug the unit, open the cover, then spin the fan by hand to confirm it is seized.
solutions.ur: Unit ka power off kar ke plug utarein, cover khol kar fan ko haath se ghuma kar confirm karein ke yeh atka hai.

solutions.en: Blow dust out of the fan and bearings with a blower; if it still does not spin freely, replace the fan.
solutions.ur: Blower se fan aur bearing ki dust nikaalein; phir bhi free na ghoomay to fan replace kar dein.

solutions.en: Check the fan connector on the board for looseness or burn marks, reconnect it, then power on once and re-check.
solutions.ur: Board par fan connector ka looseness ya burn mark check karein, connector dobara lagayein, phir ek baar power on kar ke dobara dekhein.

source.title: Ziewnic 4.5kW hybrid user manual (Scribd scan, Fault Reference §5.8)

solutions.en: Switch the unit off and let it cool for 15-20 minutes before touching anything inside.
solutions.ur: Unit switch off karke 15-20 minute thanda hone dein; thanda hone ke bawajood andar koi cheez haath na lagayein.

solutions.en: Clear the vents and cooling fins of dust and make sure the unit is not inside a closed cupboard.
solutions.ur: Vents aur cooling fins ki dust saaf karein aur confirm karein ke unit band cupboard mein na ho.

solutions.en: Reduce the load and improve airflow; if the fault returns after cooling, have the temperature sensor checked.
solutions.ur: Load kam karein aur airflow behtar karein; thanda hone ke baad bhi fault wapas aaye to temperature sensor check karwayein.

source.title: Ziewnic 4.5kW hybrid user manual (Scribd scan, Fault Reference §5.8)

causes.ur: Battery bank purani hai / cells kamzor

solutions.en: Check battery type/qty vs program settings and terminal tightness
solutions.ur: Battery type/qty program settings se check karein aur terminals tight

solutions.en: Power off; do not keep restarting — technician/repair centre required
solutions.ur: Power off; baar baar restart na karein — technician/repair centre zaroori

source.title: Ziewnic 4.5kW hybrid user manual (Scribd scan, Fault Reference §5.8)

solutions.en: Switch off the inverter and isolate AC before checking the battery; do not probe the live battery bank.
solutions.ur: Battery check karne se pehle inverter switch off karein aur AC isolate karein; live battery bank par probe na karein.

solutions.en: Measure the battery voltage with a meter; a bank far below cut-off is deeply discharged, so recharge it slowly first.
solutions.ur: Meter se battery voltage naapein; cut-off se bohat neeche ho to battery deep discharge ho chuki hai, pehle aahista se charge karein.

solutions.en: If the battery will not hold charge or is old or swollen, replace the bank and check the isolator and fuse.
solutions.ur: Battery charge na rakhe ya purani ya phooli ho to bank replace kar dein aur isolator aur fuse check karein.

source.title: Ziewnic 4.5kW hybrid user manual (Scribd scan, Fault Reference §5.8)

causes.ur: Load ki wiring gili ya short

solutions.en: Treat DC terminals as live even with breakers off
solutions.ur: Breakers off hone par bhi DC terminals ko live maan lein

solutions.en: Power off; do not keep restarting — technician/repair centre required
solutions.ur: Power off; baar baar restart na karein — technician/repair centre zaroori

source.title: Ziewnic 4.5kW hybrid user manual (Scribd scan, Fault Reference §5.8)

causes.ur: Output relay / stage ka component fail

solutions.en: Power off the unit and keep heavy loads disconnected while you check the input and output wiring.
solutions.ur: Unit ka power off karein aur input/output wiring check karte waqt bhaari loads disconnected hi rakhein.

solutions.en: With supply isolated, measure AC input and output with a meter and compare against the window in the manual.
solutions.ur: Supply isolate hue par meter se AC input aur output naapein aur manual ki window se compare karein.

solutions.en: If voltage stays outside the window on a known-good supply, do not keep restarting, send it to a repair centre.
solutions.ur: Sahi supply par bhi voltage window se bahar rahe to baar baar restart na karein, unit ko repair centre bhej dein.

source.title: Ziewnic 4.5kW hybrid user manual (Scribd scan, Fault Reference §5.8)

causes.ur: Output short se load barh jaye

solutions.en: Switch off the inverter first and disconnect high-power loads such as pumps, irons and motors before restarting.
solutions.ur: Sab se pehle inverter switch off karein aur restart se pehle pump, iron aur motor jese high-power loads disconnect kar lein.

solutions.en: Start again with the load kept below the inverter rating and add appliances one by one while watching the display.
solutions.ur: Load ko inverter rating se neeche rakh kar dobara start karein aur display dekh kar ek ek karke appliances barhayein.

solutions.en: If overload returns on light load, check the output line for a short and the motor for jamming before calling a technician.
solutions.ur: Halka load par bhi overload wapas aaye to technician bulane se pehle output line ka short aur motor ka jam check karein.

source.title: Ziewnic 4.5kW hybrid user manual (Scribd scan, Fault Reference §5.8)

meaning.ur: DC bus par over-voltage aa jana.

causes.en: Load feedback pushing the bus up
causes.ur: Load wapas energy bhej kar bus zyada

causes.en: DC link capacitor / bleed resistor fault
causes.ur: DC link capacitor / bleed resistor kharab

solutions.en: Power off the unit and disconnect AC and DC (PV isolator and battery) before any probing, the bus can stay charged.
solutions.ur: Unit ka power off karein aur kisi bhi probing se pehle AC aur DC (PV isolator + battery) disconnect kar lein, bus mein charge reh sakta hai.

solutions.en: Treat the DC terminals as live even with the breakers off, and do not open the inverter cover yourself.
solutions.ur: Breakers off hone par bhi DC terminals ko live maan lein, aur inverter ka cover khud na kholein.

solutions.en: This is an internal power-stage trip, take the unit to a technician or repair centre and do not keep restarting it.
solutions.ur: Yeh andaruni power-stage trip hai, unit ko technician ya repair centre le jayein aur baar baar restart na karein.

source.title: Ziewnic 4.5kW hybrid user manual (Scribd scan, Fault Reference §5.8)

solutions.en: Switch off the unit and isolate the supply before checking; do not keep power-cycling a failed soft-start.
solutions.ur: Check karne se pehle unit switch off karein aur supply isolate karein, soft-start fail hone par baar baar power cycle na karein.

solutions.en: With power isolated, listen for the precharge relay click at start and check the relay and its driver on the board.
solutions.ur: Power isolate hue haal mein start par precharge relay ki click sunein aur board par relay aur uska driver check karein.

solutions.en: If the relay does not click or the precharge resistor is open, have the power stage checked at a service centre.
solutions.ur: Agar relay click na kare ya precharge resistor khula ho to power stage ko service centre se check karwayein.

source.title: Ziewnic 4.5kW hybrid user manual (Scribd scan, Fault Reference §5.8)

solutions.en: Power off the unit and isolate AC first, leave the DC side isolated before probing the output stage.
solutions.ur: Pehle unit ka power off karein aur AC isolate karein, output stage par probe karne se pehle DC side isolate rehne dein.

solutions.en: Check the output wiring and load for a short, then restart once with no load to see if soft-start completes.
solutions.ur: Output wiring aur load ka short check karein, phir koi load lagaye baghair ek baar restart kar ke dekhein ke soft-start poora hota hai ya nahi.

solutions.en: If it fails again, the inverter stage needs bench diagnosis, take it to a repair centre instead of retrying.
solutions.ur: Dobara fail ho to inverter stage ki bench diagnosis chahiye, baar baar koshish ki jagah unit repair centre le jayein.

source.title: Ziewnic 4.5kW hybrid user manual (Scribd scan, Fault Reference §5.8)

title.en: Over DC in AC output / unbalanced
title.ur: AC output mein zyada DC / unbalanced

causes.ur: Output filter capacitor kamzor ho gaya

solutions.en: Switch off and isolate the unit before testing the output, DC on the AC output is unsafe to touch.
solutions.ur: Output test karne se pehle unit switch off kar ke isolate karein, AC output par DC hona chhoone ke liye khatarnak hai.

solutions.en: After isolation, measure the DC voltage on the AC output with a meter and stop if it reads high.
solutions.ur: Isolate karne ke baad meter se AC output par DC voltage naapein, zyada aaye to rok dein aur technician bulayein.

solutions.en: Do not reconnect any load until a technician has checked the output filter and relay.
solutions.ur: Output filter aur relay ke technician se check hone tak koi load dobara na lagayein.

source.title: Ziewnic 4.5kW hybrid user manual (Scribd scan, Fault Reference §5.8)

causes.ur: Current sensor board khud fail ho gaya

solutions.en: Power off and isolate the supply before opening the unit, the sensor wiring is checked only with power off.
solutions.ur: Unit kholne se pehle power off karein aur supply isolate karein, sensor wiring sirf power off par check hoti hai.

solutions.en: Check the current sensor/CT connector on the board for looseness or damage, reseat it, then power on once.
solutions.ur: Board par current sensor/CT connector ka looseness ya damage check karein, connector dobara lagayein, phir ek baar power on karein.

solutions.en: If the reading stays wrong, the sensor board must be replaced by a technician, do not keep restarting the inverter.
solutions.ur: Reading abhi bhi ghalat aaye to sensor board technician se replace karwana padega, inverter ko baar baar restart na karein.

source.title: Ziewnic 4.5kW hybrid user manual (Scribd scan, Fault Reference §5.8)

solutions.en: Power off and reduce the applied load first, then check the input wiring and connections before restarting.
solutions.ur: Sab se pehle power off kar ke applied load kam karein, phir restart se pehle input wiring aur connections check karein.

solutions.en: With supply isolated, measure input and output voltage with a meter and compare with the normal window from the manual.
solutions.ur: Supply isolate hue par meter se input aur output voltage naapein aur manual ki normal window se compare karein.

solutions.en: If input is fine but output stays low, do not keep restarting, send the unit to a repair centre.
solutions.ur: Input theek ho phir bhi output kam rahe to baar baar restart na karein, unit ko repair centre bhej dein.
